scope: Camera-only resource-tree collision filter: native query-physics tests, builds and separate normal ConstructionLab PIE restore confirmed. No physical WASD acceptance or current cooked gameplay is claimed.

evidence_origin.automation: Whitelisted fields from the final native editor automation report; raw host/device/path/instance identifiers and log messages are excluded.
evidence_origin.builds: Successful private build/repackage logs and coordinated parent confirmation. No raw logs or binaries are distributed.

source_state.scope: Hashes describe the current local source bytes, not an embedded binary source manifest. Production camera code was unchanged between the successful game build and the fixture-only editor rebuild.

collision_contract.scope: Per-query camera component filtering; no mutation of tree collision for other game actors.

repackage.method: SkipCook BuildCookRun with already cooked assets; not a new full cook

native_automation.runtime: Editor automation; controlled query-only Chaos physics worlds, without a rendered human-input test

known_warnings.summary: Existing synthetic actor cleanup has no world context.
Intentional rejection of incompatible old applied version-1 spline paint; the live world is preserved.

new_camera_test_scope.geometry: Real query-only physics geometry using Engine cube meshes in native ShaderWorld HISM pools and ordinary box components; not synthetic hit results or a forest pixel test.
verified_cases: Raw sweep confirms a real blocking tagged native pool before filtering; the camera crosses it.
Collision disabled then republished around the camera sphere produces a genuine initial penetration; the tagged-tree filter permits escape.
Untagged native SW pool, actor-only tag, and a tagged foreign HISM still block; later assertions reached after the overlap check.
A solid behind an ignored tree remains blocking, even when the ordinary solid copies the tree tag.
Initial overlap with an ordinary solid fails closed and preserves the prior camera position.
Exhausting the bounded component retry budget fails closed and preserves the prior camera position.
new_camera_test_scope.not_directly_exercised: The second sweep of a post-query ground-height correction is a controller code review finding, not a separate end-to-end controller fixture here.

historical_first_attempt.failure_scope: The old escape start was inside a one-sided complex mesh face and did not prove an initial blocking overlap. Assertions after this gate were not covered by that first run.
historical_first_attempt.correction: Fixture now places a 50 cm sphere center 25 cm outside the near face, causing 25 cm penetration; a separate raw sweep also verifies republished geometry. The strict initial-penetration assertion remains. Production collision code was not weakened.

normal_pie.runtime: Normal rendered editor PIE in ConstructionLab without a verification flag; same editor process, not a fresh cooked game process
normal_pie.evidence_origin: Two inspected private native readbacks plus the coordinated nine-point ground and camera-location comparison; raw exports, object paths and save identifiers are excluded.
normal_pie.comparison_method: Complete export_text record comparison against a backup loaded through a separate diagnostic slot; not a selected-fields-only comparison.
normal_pie.save_scope: The normal Construction save was rewritten during normal startup; its construction model is exactly equal to the checkpoint. Only the 16 unrelated saves are claimed byte-identical. No filenames or save IDs are distributed.
normal_pie.scope_limit: Startup/restore, state, ground and camera-location readbacks; no rendered held-WASD/tree-entry or mouse interaction proof.

limits: No physical held-WASD/RMB/Shift acceptance or subjective user camera-feel claim.
Successful SkipCook repackage does not establish current cooked camera gameplay or a new full cook.
Controlled native physics fixtures are separate from normal PIE, pixel comparisons and arbitrary vegetation assets.
The filter intentionally ignores an eligible whole HISM component for the single camera query; it does not change other actors collision responses.
The 32-attempt budget fails closed; it is not an unbounded path-through-all-trees guarantee.
